title: schema2object API Schema
description: JSON Schema description of the schema2object public API. ObjectTree binds data and schema into one identity. ObjectTree.from() is the external validation boundary; validate() is the standalone validation window.

resolver.description: Controls how external $ref URIs are loaded.

anyOf.description: Path to the schema file on disk. dirname(path) is used as base dir. All relative $ref paths resolve from there.
In-memory map of URI/key → schema object. $ref values looked up as keys (resolved URI first, then original ref string).
Custom loader function. Called with resolved URI string. Must return a schema object synchronously.

validateResult.description: Result of validate(). valid=true means data satisfies schema. valid=false includes error message.

error.description: Present only when valid is false.

ObjectTree.description: A schema-bound object cursor. Data and schema are one identity after the boundary has accepted the data. ObjectTree.from() validates at external entry; new ObjectTree() creates an internal cursor; property sets validate against field schemas.

_observer.description: Global observer hook for all ObjectTree instances. Set to fn(op, path, key, val, schema) to observe property access. Set to null to disable (zero cost).
_observer.x-signature: (op: 'get'|'set', path: string, key: string, val: any, schema?: object) => void
x-behavior: Called on every property get/set across all ObjectTree instances
schema parameter contains the schema node for the property (undefined if no constraint)
Cached object/array re-access does not re-emit (cache hit returns before hook)

x-constructor.throws: TypeError if schema is invalid or false. It does not validate complete external data; use ObjectTree.from(data, schema, resolver?) at the boundary.
behavior: Raw data is bound to the resolved schema as a Proxy cursor.
Defaults are read lazily and can be materialized explicitly with $withDefaults().
Object-type data: Proxy cursor wraps raw object, nested access is lazy.

$value.description: Get or set the raw data. Get returns internal data object (object schema) or scalar. Set validates against schema before storing.

x-set.throws: TypeError if value is invalid against schema.

$schema.description: Read-only. Returns the resolved schema as a plain object.

$toDict.description: Returns the schema-defined projection of data. Object nodes: only keys defined in schema.properties are included. Unknown fields are excluded. Scalar nodes: returns value directly.

$oneOf.description: Finds the exactly-matching subschema from schema.oneOf. Returns ObjectTree re-bound to that subschema.

$anyOf.description: Finds all matching subschemas from schema.anyOf. Returns array of ObjectTree, one per match.

$allOf.description: Merges all subschemas from schema.allOf into one. Returns ObjectTree re-bound to merged schema.

$notOf.description: Returns true if data does NOT match schema.not. Returns true if schema.not is absent.

$ifThen.description: Evaluates schema.if against data. If match: returns ObjectTree re-bound to schema.then. If no match: re-bound to schema.else. If neither branch defined: returns self.

$project.description: Returns a new ObjectTree containing only schema-defined properties. Same schema, subset of data. Does not re-validate.
$project.x-throws: TypeError if data is not an object.

$withDefaults.description: Returns a new ObjectTree with missing fields filled from schema 'default' values. Deep — applies defaults recursively to nested objects.
$withDefaults.x-throws: TypeError if data is not an object.

$contains.description: Returns true if at least one array element matches schema.contains. Returns null if data is not an array or schema.contains is absent.

$getSchema.description: Returns the subschema at a dot-path. Empty string returns root schema.

$getExtensions.description: Returns all x-* extension keys from the schema at a dot-path.

validate.description: Standalone validation. Validates data against schema without constructing an ObjectTree. Returns result instead of throwing.
